<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Lucas dos Santos | Portfólio</title>
<meta name="description" content="Portfólio de Lucas dos Santos: Ciência de Dados, Infraestrutura de TI e Machine Learning.">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=Sora:wght@600;700;800&display=swap">
<style>
:root{--bg:#f3f7ff;--surface:#fff;--text:#0f1f3d;--muted:#51627f;--accent:#2563eb;--accent2:#0891b2;--line:#d6e2f6;--chip:#e6efff;--on:#fff;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#08111f;--surface:#0f1b30;--text:#e6eefc;--muted:#9db0cf;--accent:#5b9dff;--accent2:#22d3ee;--line:#1d2e4d;--chip:#13284a;--on:#06101f}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#08111f;--surface:#0f1b30;--text:#e6eefc;--muted:#9db0cf;--accent:#5b9dff;--accent2:#22d3ee;--line:#1d2e4d;--chip:#13284a;--on:#06101f}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:calc(72px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px))}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:400 1rem/1.65 "IBM Plex Sans",system-ui,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:Sora,"IBM Plex Sans",system-ui,sans-serif;line-height:1.15;margin:0}
a{color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent2);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}
.wrap{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 22px}
header{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:10;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 88%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;height:64px}
.logo{font:700 1.05rem Sora,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;margin-right:auto}
nav a.l{text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:.93rem;padding:6px 2px;border-bottom:2px solid transparent}
nav a.l:hover,nav a.l.on{color:var(--text);border-color:var(--accent)}
#tema{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);border-radius:99px;padding:6px 14px;font:inherit;font-size:.85rem;cursor:pointer}
@media(max-width:760px){nav a.l{display:none}}
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr .75fr;gap:48px;align-items:center;padding:72px 0 64px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.4rem,6vw,4rem);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.role{font:600 1.35rem Sora,sans-serif;color:var(--accent);margin:14px 0 18px;min-height:2em}
.role::after{content:"";display:inline-block;width:2px;height:1.1em;background:var(--accent2);margin-left:3px;vertical-align:-.15em;animation:cur 1s steps(1) infinite}
@keyframes cur{50%{opacity:0}}
.hero p{color:var(--muted);max-width:52ch;margin:0 0 26px}
.btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:12px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface)}
.btn.p{background:var(--accent);color:var(--on);border-color:var(--accent)}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.foto{justify-self:center;width:min(300px,70vw);aspect-ratio:1;padding:5px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));box-shadow:0 20px 44px -22px var(--accent)}
.foto img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 25%;border-radius:50%;border:5px solid var(--bg)}
.hero>*{animation:in .7s both}.hero>*:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.15s}
@keyframes in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}}
@media(max-width:760px){.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding-top:40px}.foto{order:-1}}
section{padding:56px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
section h2{font-size:1.9rem;margin-bottom:26px}
.sobre{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr;gap:36px}
.sobre p{margin:0 0 14px;color:var(--muted)}
.fatos{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:20px 22px;margin:0;display:grid;gap:12px;align-self:start}
.fatos dt{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted)}.fatos dd{margin:0;font-weight:600}
@media(max-width:760px){.sobre{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.skills{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:16px}
.card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:20px 22px}
.card h3{font-size:1.02rem;margin-bottom:12px}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;padding:0;margin:0;list-style:none}
.chips li{background:var(--chip);color:var(--text);border-radius:99px;padding:5px 13px;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:500}
.tl{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0 0 0 26px;border-left:2px solid var(--line)}
.tl li{position:relative;padding-bottom:26px}
.tl li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-34px;top:6px;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);border:3px solid var(--bg)}
.tl h3{font-size:1.1rem}.tl .d{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}.tl p{margin:4px 0 0;color:var(--muted)}
.duo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:36px}
@media(max-width:760px){.duo{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.duo h2{font-size:1.5rem}
.ct{text-align:center}
.ct p{color:var(--muted);max-width:50ch;margin:0 auto 26px}
.soc{display:flex;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-bottom:22px}
.soc a{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:16px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--accent);transition:.2s}
.soc a:hover{background:var(--accent);color:var(--on);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.soc svg{width:26px;height:26px}
footer{padding:26px 0 34px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:.88rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="sobre">
<div>
<p>Sou formado em Ciência de Dados pela FATEC, com curso técnico em redes de computadores (ETEC) e a especialização em Machine Learning da Stanford University e DeepLearning.AI. Atualmente faço pós-graduação em Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning.</p>
<p>Tenho experiência prática em gestão e modelagem de dados estruturados e não estruturados, além de desenvolvimento web, integração de soluções e versionamento de código com Git e GitHub.</p>
<p>Gosto de resolver problemas complexos, trabalhar em equipe e me comunicar com clareza.</p>

})();
